senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) prudence, deliberation; subtlety. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 6 (ref. to נערמו, Ex. XV, 8, v. Targ. O. a. l.) הם אמרו הבה נתחכמה … נתת ע׳ למים they had said, Come, let us deal wisely with them (Ex. I, 10), thou, too, didst place wisdom in the water; (Yalk. Ex. 248 עַרְמוּמִית). Midr. Sam. ch. VII [read:] לפי מה שהיתה עָרְמָתוֹ של נחש כך היתה מכתו in accordance with the serpent’s subtlety was its punishment.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 1:4">Midr. Prov. ch. I</cite>. <he>פתי הייתי ונתן בי הקב״ה ע׳</he> I was simple, and the Lord placed wisdom in me.

<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מכמה שנים ואילך … להיות בו ע׳</he> from what age and onward is man expected to be deliberate?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 929:3">Yalk. ib. 929</cite>; a. e.
